investment_recommendation: Hold provisional: The deciding metric is the operating margin at 3.85% [C:operating_margin], which is slightly below peer leaders Walmart and Target (4.18% and 4.88%, respectively), indicating only moderate operating efficiency and profit expansion. This margin position, combined with strong revenue growth of 10.14% [C:revenue_growth] but a high P/E ratio of 43.58 [C:price_to_earnings], suggests valuation premium with limited margin improvement visibility. Therefore, with moderate margin and elevated valuation, the evidence supports a Hold stance until next filings clarify margin trajectory or valuation justification.
